title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Twenty Million Pesos for the Construction of Irrigation Systems

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of the proceeds of the sale of bonds under the provisions of
Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and forty, the sum of twenty million pesos, or such sum as said sales
may produce, for the construction of irrigation systems in the Philippine Islands.
The sums so appropriated shall be allotted by the Secretary of Commerce and Communications and disbursed
in accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-one hundred and fifty-two: Provided, however,
That the annual charge imposed upon each hectare of land to cover the cost of construction shall be computed,
in the case of projects the construction of which is authorized after the date of the approval of this Act, on the
basis of the total cost of construction, with interest at the rate of six per centum per annum, during a period of
twenty years.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
